title: BLiMP-RO: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Romanian
abstract: arXiv:2611.17836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating grammatical knowledge in language models requires benchmarks that cover diverse linguistic phenomena and are validated against human judgments. We introduce BLiMP-RO, a Romanian minimal-pair benchmark covering 50 grammatical phenomena across ten domains. It comprises 493 linguist-constructed sentence pairs, evaluated by native speakers in five experiments, and 5,942 additional semi-automatically generated, human-validated pairs. We further investigate grammatical generalization under limited linguistic input by training GPT-2 and GPT-BERT models from scratch on Romanian BabyBabelLM data and a newly collected corpus of 10 million words from child-targeted video captions. Increasing caption training data yields approximately 9 percentage points of accuracy improvement per tenfold increase in corpus size. translated_title: BLiMP-RO：罗马尼亚语语言学最小对立对基准测试
translated_abstract: 评估语言模型中的语法知识需要能够覆盖多样化语言现象并经过人类判断验证的基准测试。我们提出了BLiMP-RO，一个覆盖十个领域中50种语法现象的罗马尼亚语最小对立对基准测试。该基准包含493个由语言学家构建的句子对（通过五项实验由母语者进行评估），以及5,942个额外的半自动生成、经人工验证的句子对。我们进一步研究了有限语言输入下的语法泛化能力，通过在罗马尼亚语BabyBabelLM数据和新收集的1000万词儿童导向视频字幕语料库上从零开始训练GPT-2和GPT-BERT模型。增加字幕训练数据使得语料库规模每扩大十倍，准确率约提升9个百分点。在相同数据量下，BabyBabelLM总体上优于视频字幕，而GPT-BERT始终优于GPT-2。
tldr: 本文提出了BLiMP-RO——一个涵盖50种语法现象、包含493个语言学家构建及5942个半自动生成句子对的罗马尼亚语语法评测基准，并通过从零训练GPT-2和GPT-BERT模型探究了有限语言输入下的语法泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BLiMP-RO, a Romanian minimal-pair benchmark covering 50 grammatical phenomena with 493 linguist-constructed and 5,942 semi-automatically generated sentence pairs, and investigates grammatical generalization under limited linguistic input by training GPT-2 and GPT-BERT models from scratch.
